question: For ports whose status is DOWN, list each port’s ID and tenant ID along with its host, VIF type, allocated IP address, and the row number ordered by IP address (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row). Also include the tenant’s total number of DOWN ports and the average DOWN-port count across all tenants, plus the port’s MAC address, the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within its security group (ordered by standard attribute ID), the security group’s total number of DOWN ports, and that security group’s deviation from the average DOWN-port count across all security groups. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.tenant_id,
    b.host,
    b.vif_type,
    ia.ip_address,
    p.mac_address,
    sgb.security_group_id,
    p.standard_attr_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb ON sgb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT 
    b.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.ip_address ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_number_by_ip,
    SUM(b.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY b.security_group_id ORDER BY b.standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_std_attr
  FROM base b
),
tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(port_id) AS tenant_down_port_count
  FROM base GROUP BY tenant_id
),
avg_tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT AVG(tenant_down_port_count) AS avg_tenant_down_port_count FROM tenant_counts
),
sg_counts AS (
  SELECT security_group_id, COUNT(port_id) AS sg_down_port_count
  FROM base WHERE security_group_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY security_group_id
),
avg_sg_counts AS (
  SELECT AVG(sg_down_port_count) AS avg_sg_down_port_count FROM sg_counts
)
SELECT 
  w.port_id,
  w.tenant_id,
  w.host,
  w.vif_type,
  w.ip_address,
  w.row_number_by_ip,
  tc.tenant_down_port_count,
  atc.avg_tenant_down_port_count,
  w.mac_address,
  w.running_sum_std_attr,
  sc.sg_down_port_count,
  (sc.sg_down_port_count - asc.avg_sg_down_port_count) AS sg_deviation_from_avg
FROM windowed w
JOIN tenant_counts tc ON w.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id
CROSS JOIN avg_tenant_counts atc
LEFT JOIN sg_counts sc ON w.security_group_id = sc.security_group_id
CROSS JOIN avg_sg_counts asc

  p.id AS port_id,
  p.tenant_id,
  b.host,
  b.vif_type,

  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ia.ip_address) AS row_number,
  t.tenant_down_count,
  AVG(t.tenant_down_count) OVER () AS avg_tenant_down_count,
  p.mac_address,
  SUM(p.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY sgb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_std_attr,
  sg.sg_down_count,
  sg.sg_down_count - AVG(sg.sg_down_count) OVER () AS sg_deviation
FROM ports p
JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb ON sgb.port_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN securitygroups sg ON sg.id = sgb.security_group_id
JOIN (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS tenant_down_count
  FROM ports WHERE status = 'DOWN'
  GROUP BY tenant_id
) t ON t.tenant_id = p.tenant_id

  SELECT security_group_id, COUNT(*) AS sg_down_count
  FROM ports p2
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgb2 ON sgb2.port_id = p2.id
  WHERE p2.status = 'DOWN'
  GROUP BY security_group_id
) sg ON sg.security_group_id = sgb.security_group_id
WHERE p.status = 'DOWN';
